description: Source code for the implementation of GraphFunction in PyTorch JIT, including functions for graph optimization, schema generation, and execution management.

classes.name: GraphFunction
classes.description: Represents a compiled graph function in PyTorch JIT, capable of running, optimizing, and managing graph schemas.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the graph function with a given stack.

methods.name: ensure_defined
methods.description: Ensures the graph function is fully defined, invoking its creator if necessary.

methods.name: getSchema
methods.description: Returns the function schema for the graph function.

methods.name: optimized_graph
methods.description: Returns an optimized copy of the graph, performing inlining and other optimizations if needed.

methods.name: currentSpecialization
methods.description: Determines the current specialization key based on autocast settings.
